title: Spend window, 80 % notice and stop at 100 %
goal: Each cloud route keeps a rolling spend total, notifies the owner at 80 % and refuses new calls at 100 %
acceptance: Failing-first tests: 80 % notice once, 100 % stop, window reset, unknown usage counted as unknown and treated as possibly over
Reminders and local routes keep working when a cloud route stops
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the report sizes it at 3 h. Not a measurement.
